blocks.text: Mode woh qeemat (ya qeematein) hai jo data mein sab se zyada baar aati hai. Biology mein is se kisi sample ki sab se aam khasiyat (trait) samajh aati hai, jaise kisi paude par phoolon ki sab se aam tadaad, kisi population mein beejon ka sab se aam size, ya janwaron ke sample mein sab se zyada aane wala wazan.
Ungrouped data mein mode ka koi khaas formula nahi. Mode bas woh qeemat ya qeematein hain jo data mein sab se zyada baar aati hain.
Grouped data ke liye mode is formula se nikalte hain:

blocks.text_alt: Mode = l + (fm − f₁) / [(fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂)] × h

items: l = modal class (sab se zyada frequency wali class) ki nichli had (lower boundary).
f₁ = modal class se pehle wali class ki frequency.
f₂ = modal class ke baad wali class ki frequency.
h = class width (kisi class interval ki oopri aur nichli had ka farq).

blocks.text: Kitab ne 'fm = frequency of the model class' likha hai; sahih lafz 'modal class' hai (sab se zyada frequency wali class). 'Model' ka matlab namoona hai, jo yahan ghalat hai. Kitab ne f₁ ko aik jagah F₁ bhi likha hai; dono aik hi cheez hain.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
Ungrouped data ka mode (misaal)
blocks.problem: Aik biologist ne baagh ke das paudon ki unchai (cm) naapi: 50, 60, 50, 55, 50, 65, 60, 70, 55 aur 50 cm.
steps: Qadam 1: data barhti tarteeb mein: 50, 50, 50, 50, 55, 55, 60, 60, 65, 70 cm.
Qadam 2: har qeemat ki frequency ginein: 50 cm chaar baar, 55 cm do baar, 60 cm do baar, 65 cm aik baar, 70 cm aik baar.
Qadam 3: sab se zyada baar aane wali qeemat dhoondein.
blocks.answer: 50 sab se zyada (4 baar) aata hai, is liye mode 50 cm hai.

blocks.text: Farz karein hum chiriya ghar (zoo) ke janwaron ke wazan (kg) ki taqseem parh rahe hain.

blocks.caption: Chiriya ghar ke janwaron ke wazan (kitab ka table)

items: Qadam 1: modal class pehchanein: class III (30-40) ki frequency sab se zyada (18) hai, yahi modal class hai.
Qadam 2: qeematein formula mein rakhein: l = 30 (modal class ki nichli had), fm = 18, f₁ = 12 (pehle wali class II), f₂ = 10 (baad wali class IV), h = 10 (class width).

blocks.text: Yani is data ka mode 34.29 kg hai.

Modal class 30-40 hai, magar mode bilkul 30 ya 35 nahi. Formula dekhta hai ke pehle wali class (12) aur baad wali class (10) mein se kaun zyada bhari hai; baad wali kam hai, is liye mode thoda neeche, 30 ki taraf, khisak kar 34.29 kg aata hai.

blocks.explanation: 7, kyunke yeh teen baar aata hai, kisi bhi doosri qeemat se zyada.

items: Mode = sab se zyada baar aane wali qeemat (paude: 50 cm).
Grouped mode = l + (fm − f₁) / [(fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂)] × h (janwar: 34.29 kg).
